text:
maya: kicking off a short thread with the latest GPTQ bake results across Llama/Mistral/Qwen. ran heterogeneous profiles on same eval suite (HellaSwag/TruthfulQA/Squad/LLM-eval mix). attaching quick numbers, need deployment guidance.
liam: nice, can you paste the perf table?
dina: curious about token latency and kv-cache stability for long context too.
maya: numbers snapshot (quantized -> delta vs FP16 accuracy):
```
Llama-70B GPTQ-4bit: -1.8% helaswag, -2.1% truthqa, +0.3% squad; latency +12ms
Mistral-70B GPTQ-4bit: -3.5% helaswag, -4.0% truthqa, -0.7% squad; latency +9ms
Qwen-72B GPTQ-4bit: -0.9% helaswag, -1.2% truthqa, +0.1% squad; latency +15ms
```
maya: AWQ/INT8 runs looked better on Mistral for latency but had larger accuracy deltas on instruction.
noah: interesting that Qwen is holding up best accuracy-wise. did you use KV cache bypass test?
maya: yes ran long-context KV churn test: Mistral showed 2x token degradation after 8k, Llama ~1.2x, Qwen ~1.1x. suspect attention kernel mismatch under GPTQ tiled weights.
choi: any spot regressions on instruction-following (safety / refusal)?
dina: we saw a small uptick in incorrect refusals on Mistral GPTQ at ~0.8% rate vs 0.2% baseline, triggered by adversarial prompts.
liam: can you share the config used for GPTQ (group size, act-order, per-channel)?
maya: config snippet: 
```
model: gptq
bits: 4
group_size: 128
act_order: false
perchannel: true
calib_data: 2k random prompts
```
noah: calibration volume might be low for Mistral; try 5k and reduce group_size to 64. historically that reduces instruction regressions.
maya: will try. deployment question: for Dedicated pools should we serve GPTQ variants by default or keep FP16 as fallback? suggestions: route by route canary, or region split?
choi: I'd prefer route-level canary with automatic fallback to FP16 on quality regression alerts. Keep dedicated strictly for latency-sensitive routes with QPS throttles.
dina: add eval-bot checks: if eval-bot reports >0.5% drop on safety suite within 30m, auto-fallback.
liam: ops note: GPTQ models reduce memory usage by ~2.6x so fit more replicas per GPU — cost win, but KV instability + prediction delta risk. we should quantify cost per effective token with fallback rate.
maya: next runs planned: GPTQ-4b with group_size=64, calib=5k; AWQ-8b on Llama and Qwen; run full safety/regression harness and longcontext KV 12k tokens. ETA EOD tomorrow.
noah: ping me when results in, i'll spin up canary flows on staging to measure real-world hallucination deltas.
eval-bot: automated evals queued: job id eb-242468-01, suites: helaswag, truthqa, squad, safety-v2, longcontext-kv. expected finish ~6h.
maya: thanks all — quick ask: any objections to exposing Qwen-GPTQ as beta in hosted API for low-risk customers once the 64-group run passes?
dina: +1 from eval side if regressions <=0.7% across suites.
liam: +1 ops if fallback hooks and cost telemetry in console are wired.
choi: please add rollout plan to the ticket and tag eng-oncall for first 48h. :thumbsup:
maya: added plan to TICKET-ML-847, will post updates here after eb job completes.
